## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Please fix the containment check in `preview` before merging. It compares paths as text without resolving them first, so a relative path that contains `..` or goes through a symlink can read files outside the home directory. `settings_file` and the tests for it are correct.

## Critical
- app/paths.py:12 — correctness — `candidate.is_relative_to(Path(home))` compares the paths as text and never resolves them. So `preview("/home/u", "../../etc/passwd")` builds `/home/u/../../etc/passwd`, passes the check because the path still starts with `/home/u`, and returns the first 200 characters of `/etc/passwd`. A symlink inside home that points elsewhere gets through the same way. Could you resolve both paths first, e.g. `base = Path(home).resolve(); candidate = (base / relative).resolve(); if not candidate.is_relative_to(base): raise ValueError(...)`, and add a `"../outside.txt"` case to `tests/test_paths.py:19-20`? Right now that test only uses an absolute outside path. — Any caller who controls `relative` can read any file the process can read, which defeats the "outside home" guard this PR adds.

- `tests/test_paths.py:15-18` checks both the full-content case (`"hello"`) and the 200-character cutoff on a 500-character file, so an off-by-one slice would fail the test.
